verdict.rationale: BigCommerce is a hosted commerce SaaS platform, and a buyer could fairly ask whether its source is open, so the axis applies. The evidence never shows the core platform's source being readable under an open license. The only open-source mention is a separate design system for building control-panel apps, which is an adjacent component and not the product's own source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Our open source design system. Use to build BigCommerce Apps that feel native inside the control panel.
